title: TRUSTBANK uses AI agents to personalize Furusato Nozei gifts
summary: TRUSTBANK partnered with Recursive to build Choice AI using OpenAI models, enabling personalized conversational recommendations that simplify Furusato Nozei gift discovery.
body: TRUSTBANK partnered with Recursive to build Choice AI using OpenAI models, enabling personalized conversational recommendations that simplify Furusato Nozei gift discovery.
summaryZh: TRUSTBANK与Recursive合作利用OpenAI模型开发了Choice AI，通过智能对话代理简化了日本“家乡纳税”项目的个性化礼品检索与推荐流程。原始信息显示：TRUSTBANK partnered with Recursive to build Choice AI using OpenAI models, enabling personalized conversational recommendations that simplify Furusato Nozei gift discovery.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“TRUSTBANK uses AI agents to personalize Furusato Nozei gifts”。其重要性主要体现在：TRUSTBANK利用OpenAI模型构建AI代理，实现了礼品推荐的个性化对话体验。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
